effect.immortality.immortality.descripti: For the duration, fatal damage triggers a Totem of Undying effect and grants or strengthens Strength. Each death resisted stacks damage reduction and grants knockback resistance equal to that reduction (up to 100%). When the effect ends, max health is reduced by your death count during the buff; this penalty is removed after you respawn.
effect.immortality.true_power.descriptio: Attacks deal lethal damage to any target.
advancements.immortality.burn_out_body.d: Burned yourself out in endless revival.
advancements.immortality.true_power.desc: Your strength has reached an unbelievable level
